notes: LaunchToken is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with no constructor arguments. Guestbook is independent of the token and is fully configured by its nonpayable constructor with the policy-provided $owner as its immutable owner. Each address may sign once while unpaused with a message of at most 140 bytes; empty messages are allowed. Entries store the signer, timestamp and message and remain readable by index and signer while paused. Only the owner can pause or resume new signatures; entries cannot be edited or deleted, and ownership cannot be transferred. Signing requires no tokens or payment. No initialization calls are needed.
